pollen.about.text:
Detroit Pollinator Company (DPC) is a minority-owned business
                  specializing in land design consultation services to enhance
                  urban and rural communities. We transform gardens into
                  pollinator habitats and create sustainable green spaces for
                  homeowners, community organizations, and municipalities.
           
                  We understand the unique challenges and opportunities of land
                  design in Detroit. Our team of experienced professionals is
                  dedicated to crafting customized service plans that beautify
                  spaces while supporting local ecosystems and biodiversity.
            
                  Our goal is to empower individuals and organizations to create
                  environments that foster pollination, enhance landscape
                  aesthetics, and contribute positively to our neighborhoods. We
                  believe in cultivating thriving spaces for pollinators—and for
                  people.
                
                  Let's work together to make Detroit—and beyond—a greener,
                  more sustainable place for all!

content.text: Happy Bamboo
(formerly known as Zaires Visions)

is a purpose-driven company dedicated to creating healthier, more sustainable household products. Our company was built on a simple belief: everyday products should support both personal well-being and environmental responsibility.
Through our brand
Happy Bamboo
, we provide eco-friendly alternatives to traditional paper products by using
100% bamboo pulp
, a rapidly renewable resource that regenerates in just a few years without contributing to deforestation. Our products are designed to be
chemical-free, biodegradable, and septic-safe
, delivering a cleaner, more sustainable option for families, businesses, and institutions.
At Happy Bamboo, sustainability goes beyond our products. We are committed to creating
economic opportunities, supporting underserved communities, and promoting awareness around important causes such as mental health and cancer support
. Our goal is to build a brand that not only delivers high-quality products but also contributes to a healthier planet and stronger communities.
As we grow, our vision extends beyond toilet tissue into a broader line of
bamboo-based household and sustainable consumer products
, helping lead the transition toward more environmentally responsible living.
Happy Bamboo is more than a brand — it’s a mission to create lasting impact through innovation, sustainability, and community empowerment.
Ultimately, we see Happy Bamboo as more than a company — we are a
movement toward mindful consumption, equity, and lasting change
. With every product we create, we move closer to a world where businesses thrive, sustainability is the standard, and the planet flourishes alongside us.

happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.title: Sustainability
happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.description: Bamboo is one of the fastest-growing plants in the world, capable of reaching maturity in just 3-5 years. It can be harvested without killing the plant, allowing it to regenerate quickly.

happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.title: Biodegradable
happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.description: Bamboo products are biodegradable, meaning they break down naturally and do not contribute to landfill waste, unlike many plastic products.

happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.title: Carbon Sequestration
happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.description: Bamboo absorbs more carbon dioxide and releases more oxygen than many trees, contributing positively to the environment and helping to combat climate change.

happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.title: Natural Antimicrobial
happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.description: Bamboo has natural antimicrobial properties, which can help reduce bacteria and odors, making it a hygienic choice for bathroom and personal items.

happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.title: Eco-Friendly
happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.description: Bamboo requires less water and no pesticides or fertilizers to grow compared to traditional crops, reducing the ecological footprint associated with its cultivation.

happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.title: Lightweight
happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.description: Bamboo products are typically lightweight, making them easy to handle and transport, which is especially beneficial for personal items and home products.

happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.title: Versatility
happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.description: Bamboo can be used to create a wide range of products, including furniture, kitchenware, flooring, and paper. This versatility allows consumers to find bamboo options for many needs.

happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.title: Support Local Economies
happy-bamboo.homepage-benefits-list.description: Many bamboo products are sourced from local artisans and communities, supporting local economies and promoting fair trade practices.

Traditional toilet paper relies on hardwood trees that take decades to mature and require heavy chemical processing and high water usage. This contributes to deforestation, environmental strain, and potential skin irritation.
